extraction.notes: Read the preface, contents, key messages and introduction (pages 3-9, page 9 in part) and the conclusions and policy implications (pages 36-39); body chapters 2 to 5 (pages 11-35) were not extracted in this sample. Under the 0.2 Chapter 2 boundary (R8) most of the report (emigration patterns, push and pull factors, diaspora, return, skills and education, migration statistics and coordination) is out of scope; only items that link emigration to the access of North Macedonian workers to EU labour markets (Bulgarian passports giving the right to work in the EU, Germany's Skilled Labour Immigration Act, EU Talent Partnerships) are kept, as a boundary reading for the analyst to confirm. The body chapters discuss Germany's Western Balkans regulation and first work permits in the EU (pages 13-17), which may be in scope under the same reading. No item meets the technology theme materiality test. Pages 46-47 (text recognition) are blank. Revised on 29 October 2026 under extraction rules 0.2 (R1 to R11): items outside the narrower Chapter 2 boundary or materiality test removed, statuses and notes updated, repeated claims added at each place; item IDs of kept items unchanged.
